description: Example governance policy for a fictional application (Lumen Notes). Rules are data; the engine that applies them is deterministic code.

actions.name: run_tests
actions.description: Simulated test run inside the sandbox; nothing is executed.

actions.name: prepare_release
actions.description: Bump VERSION and add a CHANGELOG entry.

actions.name: publish_release
actions.description: Simulated publication: writes a simulation record, deploys nothing.

forbidden_actions.name: run_shell
forbidden_actions.reason: Agents may not run arbitrary commands.

forbidden_actions.name: deploy_production
forbidden_actions.reason: This control plane never deploys; publication is simulated only.

forbidden_actions.name: read_secrets
forbidden_actions.reason: Agents never receive credentials or secrets.

forbidden_actions.name: delete_repository
forbidden_actions.reason: Destructive repository operations are out of scope.

forbidden_actions.name: disable_tests
forbidden_actions.reason: Turning tests off to pass a gate is never allowed.

path_rules.reason: Secret material is never editable by an agent.
Data migrations are hard to reverse.
Dependency changes affect the whole application.

escalations.reason: Large change sets get a human reviewer.

requirements.summary: A plan; authorized automatically by policy.
A plan and a passing test report; authorized automatically by policy.
Plan, passing tests and a risk assessment, plus one human approver who is not the requester.
Everything HIGH needs plus a release plan, and two distinct approvers including a release manager.
